payload.text: UTILZ IS SWEPT, confirmed 2026-09-20 13:23Z by reading the run myself rather than relaying: gh run view 35512936209 reads headSha 633a1a12d, completed, success, all 7 jobs success (Test on macOS, Test on Ubuntu, Rust macos, Rust ubuntu, Rust Lint clippy, Shell Script Analysis, Test Summary). utilz-vc verified the commit independently: vendored seam only at 22 files by pathspec check, its globbing run word still matching 16 directories, and 0080's refusal DRIVEN rather than inferred from a clean doctor.
